description: Private poll-health summaries. UTC hour keys avoid repeated Warsaw-local hours at DST transitions. Metrics describe API attempts, not GPS event timestamps or operated service.

hour_fields.hour_start: UTC ISO timestamp at start of hour
hour_fields.collection_started_at: UTC ISO timestamp of first retained attempt, preserved across restarts
hour_fields.vehicle_types: object keyed by bus and tram

mode_fields.minutes: array of observed minute objects; absent minutes are unmonitored, not zero

minute_fields.attempts: number of API attempts including failures
minute_fields.successes: number of successfully parsed API responses
minute_fields.parsed_rows: sum of valid parsed records before freshness filtering
minute_fields.accepted_vehicle_count_sum: sum of distinct accepted vehicle counts per successful poll
minute_fields.accepted_line_count_sum: sum of distinct accepted line counts per successful poll

invariants: failed attempts contribute no record counts
one entry per observed minute and mode
hourly objects are cumulative snapshots, not append-only parts; retrying a snapshot must not double-count it
local health state is separate from the GPS buffer spool and retains pending uploads
